turns.question: At which hour of the day were the most page views recorded between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many page views were in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hour-of-day grain, so I cannot say which hour had the most page views; its closest metric, customer actions filtered to page_view, is available by day only. For 20 September to 3 October 2026 the busiest day was 1 October 2026 with 5 page views (10 page views across the four days that had any), and the freshness statement is: Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
